title: Logo / before and after

location.extent: Complete published video; PNG is one poster frame

slide_intent: Show what changes and what remains so an identity evolution can protect existing recognition.
strategic_value: Retaining the fast flag while redrawing the lettering and changing the palette can make Wise feel renewed without losing its identifier.
demonstration: The film contrasts a blue before signature with a green after signature, pans into letterforms, cycles color combinations and ends with the app symbol.
practical_value: Evaluate continuity in the symbol separately from changes in lettering and color.

content_islands.name: Before state
content_islands.spec: Introduce the blue signature under a small Before label.

content_islands.name: After states
content_islands.spec: Move across the redrawn green lettering, then show full signatures in several color pairs.

content_islands.name: App form
content_islands.spec: Finish with the isolated fast flag in a rounded tile.

reference_purposes.Expression: The film contrasts a blue before signature with a green after signature, pans into letterforms, cycles color combinations and ends with the app symbol.
reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying Logo section explicitly links the redraw to existing equity and scalability.
